# Fixture Robotics AG — Employee Stock Option Plan 2026

Plan summary for participants

Date:

15 February 2026

## 1. Purpose

The Employee Stock Option Plan 2026 (the "Plan" or "ESOP 2026") allows Fixture
Robotics AG (the "Company") to grant options over registered common shares to
employees, advisors and members of the board of directors.

## 2. Key terms

- Pool size: 25,000 options in total may be granted under the Plan, backed by
  the authorized capital resolved by the general meeting of 30 January 2026.
- Granted as at the Date: 0 options; 25,000 options remain available for grant.
- Exercise price: CHF 0.10 per share, equal to the nominal value.
- Vesting: four years with a one-year cliff, monthly thereafter.
- Term: options lapse ten years after the grant date.

## 3. Administration

The board of directors administers the Plan and decides on grants. Grants are
recorded in the option register kept by the Company. The pool line of the cap
table must match the pool size of this Plan until options are exercised.
